ai_summary: Avonmore Capital & Management Services Limited reported a significant turnaround in consolidated profitability for Q1 FY2026-27, posting a profit of Rs. 17.39 crore compared to a loss of Rs. 6.88 crore in the prior quarter, largely driven by strong performance in its Financial Services and NBFC segments. A key operational red flag is the Green Fuel Business's Odisha plant, which, despite being fully constructed and ready, remains unable to commence full-scale commercial production due to delays in critical procurement agreements from Oil Marketing Companies.
